stop_rules: If the complete old pool already explains a scene, preserve the result and do not force new method trials.
If no development condition is learned, skip condition validation without manufacturing labels.
If the method source cannot reconstruct the frozen body or a shared tool fails, stop before ABC scientific execution and repair the demonstrated interface.
Preserve every negative, incomplete or failed result. No replacement seed, hidden-answer injection, threshold relaxation or automatic budget transfer.
Pi2/Pi3 proposals require actual before/after role or structure evidence, not the laboratory factor label.
